description: This file defines the SsmSapClient class, a PHP client used to interact with the AWS Systems Manager for SAP service. It extends the AwsClient class and provides method annotations for various operations related to SAP management in AWS.

classes.name: SsmSapClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS Systems Manager for SAP service, extending the AWS SDK's AwsClient.

methods.description: Deletes resource permission in the AWS Systems Manager for SAP service. Has an async counterpart.
